title: Guozijian
subtitle: An institutional entry into classical education and state knowledge
shortSummary: The Guozijian connects the Five Classics, commentary, examination and state education within a traceable institutional line.
curatorialDescription: Starting from the Guozijian places Kong Yingda and the Corrected Meanings within an institutional setting rather than presenting them only as individual scholarship.
The record keeps the institution's educational and political functions visible; buildings, offices and reforms require period-specific records.
researchNote: Tang institutional changes, exact location, curriculum and the compilation and circulation of the Corrected Meanings still need verification.
